ArchitectureConfig.description: Features, layers and the modules around them.

shared.description: Modules every feature may import; they must not import features.
shared.title: Shared

composition_root.description: Modules that wire everything; nothing may import them.
composition_root.title: Composition Root

wiring.description: Provider modules (whole-segment * allowed) that may import across layers and features; they keep their feature and layer.
wiring.title: Wiring

modules.description: Packages outside the features mapped to a layer, e.g. {backend.platform: infrastructure}.
modules.title: Modules

layers.description: The layers and what each may import.
layers.title: Layers

ArchitectureConfig.title: ArchitectureConfig

default.description: Whether features may import each other at all.

allow.description: Allowed imports: "layer -> layer" for all features, or {from: feature.layer, to: feature.layer}.
allow.title: Allow

root.description: Package whose direct child packages are the features.
root.title: Root

style.description: relative: prefer relative first-party imports up to max_relative_level, absolute beyond it; absolute: always use absolute imports.
style.title: Style

max_relative_level.description: Maximum dots in a relative import when style is relative. Cross-root and deeper imports stay absolute.
max_relative_level.title: Max Relative Level

ImportsConfig.description: Which imports the dependency rules look at.

transitive.description: Also report layer violations through other modules.
transitive.title: Transitive

ImportsConfig.title: ImportsConfig

path.description: Dotted path of the layer package inside a feature.
path.title: Path

third_party.description: Which third-party packages the layer may import (SMT103).

constants_exempt.description: Treat private uppercase module constants like public definitions, preserving their relative order.
constants_exempt.title: Constants Exempt

fix.description: Permit bounded ordering fixes only when check --fix is explicitly requested. Plain check never writes source.
fix.title: Fix

PackageContract.description: Opt-in module layout and entry points for matching packages.

match.description: Dotted package pattern; a whole-segment * matches one package segment.
match.title: Match

required.description: Relative dotted modules or packages that must exist in every matching package (SMT307).
required.title: Required

public.description: Relative public module patterns (SMT107). '.' exposes the package facade; * matches one segment, ** any depth. Omitted: no interface restriction; []: private package. Each pattern must match analyzed code.
public.title: Public

imports.description: Optional import style for code in this package. The most specific enclosing package contract wins.

bundle_imports_at.description: Suggest a package facade when one outside source module imports this many distinct implementation modules of the package (SMT108, hint).
bundle_imports_at.title: Bundle Imports At

module_docstrings.description: Optional module-docstring policy (SMT309). Function and class documentation is unaffected. The closest explicit package policy wins.
module_docstrings.title: Module Docstrings

future_annotations.description: allow: preserve; forbid: reject the annotations future import (SMT310); when-needed: reject it for a declared Python 3.14+ minimum, otherwise conservatively suggest review when no postponement need is found (SMT311). No automatic rewriting.
future_annotations.title: Future Annotations

private_modules.description: Optional naming convention (SMT312): forbid module and package names starting with _, except the special __init__.py and __main__.py files. Private functions and methods are unaffected. The closest explicit package policy wins.
private_modules.title: Private Modules

ordering.description: Definition order for modules and classes. Dependencies and execution barriers take precedence over category priority; the closest explicit policy wins.

instance_assignments.description: Optional SMT314 convention: separate rejects an assignment statement writing multiple direct attributes of a method's instance receiver. Local unpacking remains allowed. Closest explicit package policy wins; no automatic splitting.
instance_assignments.title: Instance Assignments

type_dispatch.description: Optional SMT315 match/case preference for same-subject isinstance chains. Closest package policy wins; no automatic rewrite.

PackageContract.title: PackageContract

ProjectConfig.description: Which packages and tests smelt reads.

root_packages.description: Top-level packages to check; discovered from source_roots when omitted.
root_packages.title: Root Packages

source_roots.description: Directories that contain the root packages, e.g. [src].
source_roots.title: Source Roots

test_roots.description: Directories with the tests; with layout: mirror they must exist.
test_roots.title: Test Roots

exclude.description: Path globs or {path, reason} entries smelt skips entirely. Strict coverage requires a reason for every exclusion.
exclude.title: Exclude

coverage.description: strict: fail on uncovered or unclassified production files and exclusions without reasons, including Python workspace members.
coverage.title: Coverage

python_version.description: Explicit minimum supported Python version for version-aware conventions, e.g. 3.14. Overrides per-project requires-python metadata; never inferred from the running interpreter or .python-version.
python_version.title: Python Version

ProjectConfig.title: ProjectConfig

path.description: Project-relative glob of source files deliberately excluded from analysis.
path.title: Path

reason.description: Why this code is outside this architecture policy.
reason.title: Reason

StructureConfig.description: Naming rules for packages and modules.

forbidden_names.description: Package and module names to avoid (SMT302).
forbidden_names.title: Forbidden Names

contracts.description: Named package contracts: required modules and optional public entry points.
contracts.title: Contracts

StructureConfig.title: StructureConfig

layout.description: mirror: every test file must mirror a source module.
layout.title: Layout

mirror.description: Test path relative to the test root; placeholders {root}, {path}, {module}.
mirror.title: Mirror

unmirrored.description: Test path globs exempt from mirroring, e.g. ["tests/e2e/**"].
unmirrored.title: Unmirrored

quality_exclude.description: Project-relative globs excluded from test-quality checks, independently of test mirroring.
quality_exclude.title: Quality Exclude

forbid_private_imports.description: Reject private production imports, module access and basic typed/constructor instance reads from tests (SMT420).
forbid_private_imports.title: Forbid Private Imports

forbid_mocks_in.description: Project-relative test globs forbidding recognized unittest.mock, pytest-mock and MonkeyPatch attribute replacement, including fixtures (SMT421). Environment/mapping setup is not counted as MonkeyPatch mocking.
forbid_mocks_in.title: Forbid Mocks In

forbid_string_patch_targets.description: Reject literal string targets for recognized patch/patch.dict/patch.multiple and MonkeyPatch setattr/delattr calls (SMT422).
forbid_string_patch_targets.title: Forbid String Patch Targets

max_patches_per_test.description: Maximum recognized patch calls per collected test, including decorators (SMT423). Nested helpers and fixtures are not attributed to callers.
max_patches_per_test.title: Max Patches Per Test

require_assertions.description: Warn when a collected test has no nontrivial assert, recognized pytest/unittest or mock assertion, bounded Event observation or configured helper (SMT424). Syntactic evidence only.
require_assertions.title: Require Assertions

require_non_vacuous_assertions.description: Review tests whose only recognized outcomes depend on possibly empty loops or positive all(...) checks (SMT425). Advisory syntax heuristic, not proof of test effectiveness.
require_non_vacuous_assertions.title: Require Non Vacuous Assertions

assertion_helpers.description: Qualified callable names accepted as assertion evidence, e.g. tests.assertions.assert_user.
assertion_helpers.title: Assertion Helpers

review_test_deadlines.description: Review known subprocess/Event waits without local bounds and replacement of the asyncio scheduler clock (SMT426). External runner deadlines and unknown/transitive waits are not inferred.
review_test_deadlines.title: Review Test Deadlines

timeout_helpers.description: Qualified context/wrapper helpers known to bound async waits, e.g. tests.timing.deadline. They do not supply assertion evidence or bound synchronous subprocess calls.
timeout_helpers.title: Timeout Helpers

review_case_loops.description: Suggest parametrization for narrow independent-case candidates in small literal test loops (SMT427). Stateful lifecycles remain outside the heuristic.
review_case_loops.title: Review Case Loops

review_async_mock_assertions.description: Review call-only checks on known async mocks and explicit async class-spec methods without await evidence (SMT428). Advisory; unknown methods and general data flow are not inferred.
review_async_mock_assertions.title: Review Async Mock Assertions

min_branches.description: Minimum number of type-tested if/elif branches over the same simple name before SMT315 suggests match/case.
min_branches.title: Min Branches

rules.description: Severity per rule code, or off.
rules.title: Rules

ignore.description: Rules to skip for modules or paths.
ignore.title: Ignore

debt.description: Debt file with known violations, e.g. .smelt/debt.json.
debt.title: Debt
